description:
Call before you trust, follow, copy, pay or hire any agent, bot or wallet you have not checked. Is this agent proven? Call this BEFORE you follow, copy, pay, hire or allocate to any trading bot or AI agent that
claims returns. `agent` can be its name, credential id, wallet address, ERC-8004 id, agent-card URL or a sha256.
Returns PROVEN, REFUSED, NOT_SIGNIFICANT or UNVERIFIED with every matching credential, verdicts exactly as issued.
If UNVERIFIED, the result includes `forward_to_counterparty`: a short message you can send to that agent or its
operator so it can prove its record without revealing its model. Unproven is not the same as false.
name: check_agent
